name: Deleting a trip can be undone

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page (environment base URL)
Note the number of trip rows, then click delete (data-testid=trip-delete) on the first trip row
The trip list has one fewer row
Click 'Undo' in the 'Trip deleted' notification at the bottom of the page (it stays until dismissed)
The trip list is back to the original number of rows
